facts.fact: CIVICUS Monitor reports the General Student Union of Burkina Faso (UGEB) issued a statement criticising the government's security record and the military authorities' failure to restore security.

CIVICUS Monitor reports the Minister of Territorial Administration suspended UGEB for three months on 26 May 2026 after its statement, and the Ouagadougou prosecutor opened an investigation into its authors.
CIVICUS Monitor reports the Higher Council for Communication indefinitely suspended TV5 Monde broadcasts on 5 May 2026 (decision 2026-018/CSC) over its coverage of terrorism and Mali.
CIVICUS Monitor reports imam Mohamad Ishaq Kindo was arrested on 26 May 2026 after publicly criticising a religious freedom bill.

BFA.note: The document states nothing on registration, documents or digital access for refugees or displaced people.
